label: Ignatius of Antioch addresses the church at Tralles

date.note: Ignatius wrote en route to martyrdom at Rome. Eusebius (Hist. eccl. 3.36) places the journey under Trajan (reigned 98–117), traditionally c. 107–110; the range brackets the later part of Trajan's reign. A minority redates the letters to c. 125–150 (Barnes 2008).

primary.cite: Ignatius, To the Trallians, salutation; also 1 (their bishop Polybius)

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, p. 186

notes: Tralles ad Maeandrum (Pleiades 599987), not the late 'Tralleis in Lydia' resource (614866, dated 300–640). The Apocalypse does not mention Tralles; Harnack p. 186 pairs it with Magnesia as 'earlier than Trajan's reign, undoubtedly (see Ignatius).' Ignatius names Polybius as their bishop.
